definition: One `.mdx` file under `content/recipes/`; all its data is YAML front matter
A recipe's URL name, `/recipe/<slug>`; unique across every source folder
Where a recipe came from: `youtube`, `notes` or `manual`, and the folder it lives in
The pass by `scripts/rewrite_recipes.py` in which Claude cleans a new recipe's title, ingredients and steps
The Cloudflare Worker `recipe-book` that serves the site, built with OpenNext
